# tls — TLS servers

[All groups](README.md)

## tls probe

Connect to a TLS server (directly, or via LDAP or SMTP StartTLS) and report the negotiated version, cipher and ALPN, the certificate chain and whether it verifies for the host, OCSP stapling (the stapled response is validated; ocsp=true also queries the responder, crl=true checks the CRL), which TLS versions are accepted, and whether the server asks for a client certificate and from which CAs. Can present a client certificate for mutual TLS.

MCP tool: `tls_probe`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--host` | string | host, host:port, or a URL (https://, ldaps://, ldap://, smtp://). **Required.** |
| `--port` | int | Port when host has none. Default `443`. |
| `--starttls` | string | Upgrade a plain connection first. Default `none`. One of `none`, `ldap`, `smtp`. |
| `--sni` | string | Server name to send and verify, if not the host. |
| `--alpn` | list | ALPN protocols to offer. Default `h2,http/1.1`. |
| `--roots` | string | PEM roots to trust instead of the system store. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--mtls-cert` | string | Client certificate (PEM, may include its chain) for mutual TLS. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--mtls-key` | string | Private key for mtls_cert. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--versions` | bool | Also test which TLS versions the server accepts (direct TLS only). Default `true`. |
| `--ocsp` | bool | Also ask the leaf certificate's OCSP responder for its status (a stapled response is always checked). |
| `--crl` | bool | Also download the leaf certificate's CRL and check it is not listed. |
| `--allow-private-urls` | bool | Let URLs taken from certificates (OCSP responders, caIssuers) reach loopback, private or link-local addresses, for an internal PKI. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
